content: A kurana wurdu ad Yasu
Ka fiwandal Sǝɗikw Chuwaɗaɗan ad Yasu da tǝghal kǝ kurakura kǝ wurdu.
A zǝɓga Yasu ad ndǝl khǝna kul ufaɗ viɗa zǝ fatsi. Kǝ khala ka ndzikǝnǝf way.
Ka sa wurdu niya tsin, “Da zǝr Yazhigǝl kha, kwarara kwara kǝ kurakhan nalnǝg itar kǝ dǝg zu.”
Ka ngawarkhe Yasu kwarne, “Vindzan ǝn kaɗkaɗ Yazhigǝl kwarne, ‘Uk ǝn safǝn tǝ dǝg zuwa kitakul bud bi, khekwa dǝ itsera kǝ lave ǝn sǝgawal ǝn ghay kǝ Yazhigǝl.’ ”
Ka ɓala wurdu da dlǝmdla kǝs Chuwaɗaɗan ǝn Wurshalim, ka ɓoɓa tsin da tǝ ghǝr kǝ beɗem fǝta Yazhigǝl.
Niya tsin, “Da zǝr Yazhigǝl kha,” ghǝdzǝvdagh ghǝdzǝva dǝg dagh da khay, wirva vindzan kwarne,

content.text: “ ‘Da batra bǝg Yazhigǝl ad ndzǝɗa kǝ zarɓǝlakh sar kǝ kat kha kat.
Ka da chau kha chawa itar dǝ dǝv tar.
Khek kǝɗkhe kǝ kur ǝn tǝ sig.’ ”

content: Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “Vindzan tsugun kwarne, ‘Kura ba dǝ Dad zikan Yazhigǝla bi.’ ”
Ka gwidǝn wurdu ad ɓoɓa dǝgo da tǝ tsǝɓan na kǝ ghay ghuɓ, ka mǝdlaran ad tlǝksakh lard zǝ zika khwara sar daghan.
Ka niya tsin, “Da kǝla ke kha juguv ɗaba ke kh. Daghan dǝgakhana da bakha bǝg kǝ.”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, Tsiya dǝgal ǝn van kha shatan, wirva vindzan kwarne, “ ‘Ɗabaɗaba Dad zikan Yazhigǝlakh, tsuguna in kitakul da manara kha tlǝr.’ ”
Khalak yana ka ɗuwars wurdu, ka sǝgdagh kǝ zarɓǝlakh Yazhigǝl da nǝgharu nǝgh.
A farsa Yasu ad tlǝr sar ǝn Galili
Tsǝna kǝ Yasu kwarne a viyava Yukhan da sal, ka tsiya tsin dǝgal da Nazarat ǝn Galili.
Ka ɗuwars ad Nazarat, dal da giɗǝn Kafarnakhum, ai tǝvai ǝn tuk dǝlv ǝn tǝ ghala ǝntla khaya Zǝbulun zǝ Naftali.
Ki da righada lave kwarga Yazhigǝl ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ Ishay tlayang kwarne,

content.text: “Əntla khay mbǝrt Zebulun, zǝ dǝg Naftali ǝn Galili.
Ən tǝ ɗul dǝlva Madateri, tangw da tǝ ǝntla khay zagha Urdun,
Galili vake ǝn giɗda liye kwal Yakhudakh.
Liye giɗǝn kǝs sǝɗikw fayam ǝmtsa.
A mǝdlawala kheɗaɗa kes da vak tar.”

content: Tsif tǝ yanen kǝ sart, a farsa Yasu ad kwardu lav Yazhigǝl, ǝn kwar kwarne, “Pǝlam pǝla ghǝr, wirva tlǝksa Yazhigǝl a khǝrzǝgan.”
A ɗakhga Yasu ad li vay kilf ud ufaɗ
Madǝv Yasu ǝn dǝgal ǝn tǝ kalam dǝlva Galili ma, ka nǝghanǝgha tsin zarbabakh mits, Simane ɗakhdud dǝ Bitrus zǝ zer bab sar Ndros. Ən ɗay sika vay kilf itar da dǝlv, wirva li vay kilf itar.
Ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Gatamakǝs gat, da nakurar nǝg ka kǝ li khutsado ud ndǝkve ǝn vaya kur kilf.”
Tǝvin tǝvina ka ɗuwars itar ad sikakh tar, ka gatars itar.
Din ǝn zu vuk dǝ dǝga, ka nǝghan ad yakhaya kǝ zarbabakh mits tsugun, ai Yakub zǝr Zabadi zǝ zer bab sar Yukhan. Ən peryu itar zǝ dad tar Zabadi, ǝn ɗika sikakh tar itar. Ka ɗakh tǝrkhai.
Tǝvin tǝvina ka ɗuda itar peryu tar zǝ dad tar, ka gatars itar.
A mǝlaru Yasu kǝ udakh zikǝn
A gwayafkhai Yasu ǝn kǝs Galili daghan, ǝn tsagakhdu lav Yazhigǝl ǝn gud dzakhav Yakhudakh. Ka kwardu lav zǝɗǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝksa yazhigǝl. Ən mbakha itsera kǝ khulf kuz, zǝ liye kwal yang kǝ udakh.

A tsa tǝ dǝva dǝ yan kǝ tlǝr ud ad Yasu ǝn khay ya Suri daghan. Ka zaɓardo li kwal yang ud zǝ liye ǝn tuk kuzakh sikh sikh sikh zǝ li khǝɓ dlaɗ, zǝ li sǝɗikw bǝzan, zǝ liye tlavarghǝr wurdu zǝ li ǝmtsa kalam vǝgh, a mbakhatru daghan.
A gatars dzakhava udakh zikǝn sǝgawal ǝn Galili, zǝ ǝntla khaya kǝsakh kǝlɗǝk, zǝ Wurshalim, zǝ ǝntla khaya Yakhudi, zǝva liye ǝn ghǝdzǝva zagha Urdun.
